attributes.context: The chunk first describes the baseline payroll practice: if a pay date falls on a weekend or holiday, checks are issued on the last duty day no more than two days before that weekend or holiday.

extraction_text: In the event the District wishes to change the payroll practices from those set forth above, upon receipt of written notice to the Association, the parties agree to reopen negotiations on payroll practices including, but not limited to the number of pay periods, implementation of a “paperless pay stub” system and/or an attendance/payroll tracking procedure.
